mapper.insert: INSERT INTO herb_atlas_feature ( atlas_id, species_id, feature_code, feature_vector, feature_dimension, feature_model, feature_version, extract_status, extract_time, error_message, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{atlasId}, #{speciesId}, #{featureCode}, #{featureVector}, #{featureDimension}, #{featureModel}, #{featureVersion}, #{extractStatus}, #{extractTime}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT 'atlas' AS target_type, atlas_id AS target_id, atlas_id, species_id, feature_code, feature_vector, feature_dimension, feature_model, feature_version, extract_status, extract_time, error_message FROM herb_atlas_feature WHERE atlas_id = #{atlasId} AND extract_status = 'success' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY extract_time DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
